info.description: Reusable orbiting light effect for badges, cards, buttons, containers, etc.

enabled.description: Enable orbiting light animation around element border

speed.description: Animation speed: extra-slow (10s), slow (5s), medium (3s), fast (1.5s)

size.description: Size of orbiting light dot: xs (tiny, 2px), small (subtle, 4px), medium (balanced, 6px), large (prominent, 8px)

color.description: Hex color for orb glow (e.g., #22c55e). Leave empty to use theme primary color.

blur.description: Blur intensity in pixels (0-100). Higher = softer glow.
